description: Walk a path and return the id it names. A path is a QUERY on Drive, not an address: two objects may hold the same name in one folder, and this reports that as an error listing both ids rather than picking one. Use it before any tool that writes. A Drive name may itself contain a slash (Google Meet writes folders like "Weekly sync - 2030/01/15"); those are reachable only by id, which find_files returns.
name: resolve_path
title: Resolve a path to an id
